posts.title: Match Emacs and GNOME light/dark theme
posts.description: 2026 May 23 Light or dark? GNOME side I like both, depending on how much light is in the room. I much prefer to set my desktop light or dark manually than to automate with timers. On GNOME light or dark is color-scheme and you can set read and set it from the command line. You can read it from the command line (default light theme is called default ) $ gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface col

posts.title: Embedding a Mastodon thread as comments to a blog post
posts.description: 2026 Apr 15 I wrote org-static-blog-emfed , a little Emacs package that extends org-static-blog with the ability to embed a Mastodon thread in a blog post to serve as comments . The root of the Mastodon thread also serves as an announcement of the blog post to your followers. It’s based on Adrian Sampson’s Emfed, and of course Bastian Bechtold’s org-static-blog . posts.title: My first advice! (in Emacs Lisp)
posts.description: 2026 Apr 04 It was really fun to learn about advising Lisp functions to extend functionality in Emacs.
